newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to free guerrilla early for good behaviour.
newsitem.headline: Greece to free guerrilla early for good behaviour.

text.p: Convicted Pan American airline bomber Mohammed Rashid will be freed from a Greek prison early because of good behaviour and sent to the Palestinian entity, his lawyer said on Wednesday.
"The three-member Athens appeals court ruled in favour of our appeal. He will be out in a few days, perhaps even as early as today," lawyer Spyros Fitrakis told Reuters.
Rashid was arrested at Athens airport in 1988 and convicted of the mid-air bombing of a Pan American airliner in 1982 which killed a Japanese teenager and wounded 15 other passengers.
Rashid, who claimed throughout that he was the victim of mistaken identity, was sentenced to 18 years by an Athens court in 1992 but later had his sentence reduced to 15 years.
A U.S. embassy spokesman in Athens said: "We believe that convicted terrorists should serve their term."
The appeals court ruled that Rashid should be release after serving about half of his term and satisfying the court of his good behaviour. His pre-trial detention is counted towards his term.

Rashid was arrested on a tip-off by U.S. officials and his trial became a test-case for U.S.-Greek relations. Greece refused to extradite Rashid to the United States but agreed to put him on trial in Athens for the bombing.
